messages:
Alex: CI microbench failure on PR #21555 — kv-hotpath regression. bench bot posted a 12% tail-latency increase and 8% drop in kv-hit rate on the staging matrix.
bench-ci-bot: microbench kv_hotpath (seq=32) thrpt: 5400 -> 4980 rps (-7.8%), p95 latency: 12.1ms -> 13.6ms (+12.4%)
Priya: Can someone repro locally? If it's consistent we need a bisect.
Miguel: Repro and quick run:
```
./ci/run_micro.py --bench kv_hotpath --seed 42 --iters 200
# before: thrpt 5420 rps, p95 11.9ms
# after: 4995 rps, p95 13.4ms
```
Miguel: Flamegraph points to increased time in kv::evict_if_needed and kernel::select_path
Zoe: FYI my PR (21480) bumped kernel-autoselect threshold and adjusted kv eviction window by -5ms. @Alex @Priya
Alex: That combo could change kernel choice for mid-seqlen requests, and cause less-prefetch-friendly kernels to be used -> lower kv hits
Priya: Quick bisect plan: revert autoselect tweak first, rerun microbench in CI. If fixed, then the autoselect change is culprit.
Priya: I'll queue a revert candidate.
Miguel: Local quick test reverting the threshold gives thrpt 5380 rps, p95 12.0ms (back near baseline)
bench-ci-bot: Rerun queued at https://ci.internal/teams/eng-runtime/21555/bench-rerun
Zoe: Opening revert PR now. Also adding a perf unit test that asserts kv-hitrate doesn't drop >3% in the microbench.
Alex: Good. If revert clears CI we'll ship revert as emergency and follow up with a targeted fix for eviction heuristic.
Priya: Also adding a short note to the release checklist: run kv-hit microbench after kernel-autoselect changes.
Zoe: :thumbsup: will post PR link when ready.
Alex: Thanks — keeping this thread for the rollback decision and postmortem notes
